tagline: A global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Holcim achieves record recurring EBIT margin of 18.1% on a 12-month rolling basis at Q1 2026, industry-leading. This performance reflects operational excellence, cost discipline, portfolio mix-up with sustainable products, and reduced exposure to energy cost volatility through alternative fuels.

kpis.name: Recurring EBIT Margin (12-month rolling)
kpis.explanation: Recurring operating profit margin calculated on a 12-month rolling basis, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Recurring EBIT margin reaches 18.1% on a 12-month rolling basis at Q1 2026, up 40 basis points, confirming Holcim's leadership position in the building materials industry.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company in the first quarter.
kpis.description: Net sales reach CHF 3,520 million at Q1 2026, up 3.9% on an organic basis, driven by significant momentum in March and leadership positions in attractive markets.

kpis.name: Recurring EBIT
kpis.explanation: Recurring operating result of the group in the first quarter.
kpis.description: Recurring EBIT amounts to CHF 431 million at Q1 2026, up 8.3% on an organic basis, supported by premium and sustainable product offerings, strict cost discipline, and operational excellence.

kpis.name: Quarterly Recurring EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Recurring operating profit margin for the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.description: Q1 2026 recurring EBIT margin reaches 12.2%, down 90 basis points, impacted by scope effects from acquisitions completed in the first quarter.
kpis.signal: Quarterly margin impacted by scope effects

kpis.name: Alternative Fuels Rate (Europe)
kpis.explanation: Ratio of thermal energy from alternative fuels to total thermal energy consumed in cement kilns in Europe.
kpis.description: Alternative fuels utilization rate in Europe reaches 70% at Q1 2026, protecting Holcim from energy price exposure and supporting the 90% target for Europe by 2030.
kpis.signal: Increased protection against energy price volatility

kpis.name: Energy Costs as % of Sales
kpis.explanation: Share of fuel and electricity costs in net sales.
kpis.description: Energy costs (fuels and electricity) represent 8% of sales in 2025, down 3 percentage points versus 2022, thanks to operational excellence, increased alternative fuels, and renewable energy.
kpis.signal: Major reduction in energy cost exposure

kpis.name: ECOPact Sales Mix (Ready-Mix Concrete)
kpis.explanation: Share of ECOPact low-carbon concrete sales in total ready-mix concrete net sales.
kpis.description: ECOPact represents 31% of ready-mix concrete sales at Q1 2026, versus 29% at Q1 2025, reflecting strong and growing demand for sustainable building materials.

kpis.name: ECOPlanet Sales Mix (Cement)
kpis.explanation: Share of ECOPlanet low-carbon cement sales in total cement net sales.
kpis.description: ECOPlanet represents 39% of cement net sales at Q1 2026, up 4 percentage points from 35% at Q1 2025, demonstrating the success of Holcim's sustainable offering.

kpis.name: Recycled Construction and Demolition Materials Volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of recycled construction and demolition materials, in millions of tonnes.
kpis.description: Holcim recycled 1.8 million tonnes of construction and demolition materials at Q1 2026, up 24%, supported by increased capacity and growing demand for circular ECOCycle materials.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow Target
kpis.explanation: Cash generation target after investments for fiscal year 2026.
kpis.description: Holcim confirms its free cash flow target of approximately CHF 2 billion for fiscal year 2026, demonstrating solid cash generation despite investments in decarbonization and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of CHF 3.1 in latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of CHF 1.714 billion in latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 13.0% in latest year.

kpis.name: ECOPact Sales Mix (Ready-Mix Concrete)
kpis.explanation: Share of ECOPact low-carbon concrete sales in total ready-mix concrete net sales.
kpis.description: ECOPact represents 31% of ready-mix concrete sales at Q1 2026, versus 29% at Q1 2025, reflecting strong and growing demand for sustainable building materials.

kpis.name: Recycled Construction and Demolition Materials Volume
kpis.explanation: Volume of recycled construction and demolition materials, in millions of tonnes.
kpis.description: Holcim recycled 1.8 million tonnes of construction and demolition materials at Q1 2026, up 24%, supported by increased capacity and growing demand for circular ECOCycle materials.

kpis.name: AI Impact Target on EBIT (2028)
kpis.explanation: Expected contribution of artificial intelligence initiatives to recurring EBIT by 2028.
kpis.description: Holcim targets CHF 200 million contribution to recurring EBIT by 2028 through AI initiatives in logistics, production, commercial, and administration.

ai_positioning.summary: Holcim deploys an ambitious AI strategy targeting CHF 200 million impact on recurring EBIT by 2028. AI is integrated across four pillars: logistics (supply chain and distribution optimization), production (manufacturing excellence and procurement), commercial (customer experience improvement), and administration (operational efficiency).
evidence: Quantified target: CHF 200M recurring EBIT contribution by 2028
AI deployment across 4 strategic pillars: Logistics, Production, Commercial, Administration
Focus on supply chain optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer experience
